question: Which repeated high-cost Abaqus API misunderstandings can be converted into narrow, licensed, traceable cards without expanding the global Skill or adding model templates?

trace_inventory.selection_rule: Promote only repeated consumer/container behavior that is not obvious from the callable signature and can be reproduced by a minimal Abaqus 2024 micro-regression.
not_promoted: Part.SectionAssignment.region and Model.FieldOutputRequest import step are already explicit in official parameter/Access text and exact signatures.
Model.BeamSection unsupported orientation/geometricType keywords are already covered by automatic_exact_signature; no case recipe was added.
ModelJob.writeInput, Part.seedPart, Assembly.Set, and Part.Set owner mistakes already receive exact legal alternatives or existing verified notes.
No center-hole, material-partition, SurfaceTraction direction, or complete B31 solution template was added.

new_verified_notes.limit: B31/Static only; it does not define valid output variables for other element or procedure families.

catalog_merge_correction.problem: Part.generateMesh was split into two cards inherited from MeshEditPart and MeshPart, so an exact public receiver lookup returned ambiguous even though both signatures belong to Part.
catalog_merge_correction.correction: Merge non-constructor sibling-mixin records only when every card exposes the same public canonical method and their abqpy records share a base; preserve both signatures and source records.
catalog_merge_correction.result: Part.generateMesh now resolves to one public-overload card with two signatures; Spot.__init__ remains ambiguous because constructors are excluded.

interpretation.capability: final10 can return narrow, verified container and ODB-boundary guidance for six additional exact method/parameter queries and resolves the Part.generateMesh public overload deterministically.
interpretation.expected_cost_effect: The notes target failures that historically consumed extra CAE or standalone Abaqus Python calls. Deterministic and licensed evidence proves card correctness, not that a Product Agent will query, receive, adopt, or save calls.
limits: No Product-Agent treatment batch has yet measured final10 adoption or call reduction.

Automatic modes still require a traceback that resolves to the owning method; IndexError, raw JSON TypeError, and attribute-only ODB errors may not route to FieldOutput.getSubset or openOdb automatically.
The B31 FieldOutputRequest note is explicitly element/procedure bounded and must not be used as a general output-variable table.
Card count changed from 5481 to 5480 because two legitimate Part.generateMesh overload records were merged, not because a source record was deleted.
